map.根据修复牙位、美学需求与比色，推荐合适的氧化锆材料代次（3Y-5Y）与透光率，平: Recommends a suitable zirconia generation (3Y-5Y) and translucency by restoration site, aesthetic need and shade, balancing strength and aesthetics.
map.⚠️ 氧化锆透光率与强度呈反比。高透光率材料美学佳但强度降低，需根据牙位与咬合力: Zirconia translucency and strength are inversely related. High-translucency materials look better but lower strength; weigh by site and occlusal force.
map.后牙冠/长桥，遮色强: Posterior crown / long bridge, strong masking

map.• 变色基牙/种植体 → 3Y 遮色层 + 5Y 饰面瓷（分层）: Discolored abutment / implant -> 3Y masking layer + 5Y veneering porcelain (layered)
map.参考：口腔修复学氧化锆陶瓷材料章节；ISO 6872 牙科陶瓷标准。: Reference: Prosthodontics zirconia ceramic materials chapter; ISO 6872 dental ceramic standard.
map.前牙全瓷修复，输入牙位与比色，工具推荐高透代次并提示唇面饰瓷。: For anterior all-ceramic restoration, enter site and shade; the tool recommends a high-translucent generation and suggests labial veneering.
map.后牙高咬合力区，权衡强度优先选常规透代次。: For posterior high-occlusal-force zones, favor strength and choose conventional-translucent generation.
map.比色差异明显，提示透光率匹配邻牙以避免死白。（结果仅供口腔健康科普与自我初筛参考: Obvious shade difference suggests matching translucency to neighboring teeth to avoid dead white. map.输入：上颌侧切牙，美学需求高，比色 1M1\n输出：推荐 5Y 高透氧化锆，透光:
Input: maxillary lateral incisor, high aesthetic need, shade 1M1
Output: recommend 5Y high-translucent zirconia, translucency close to natural enamel; posterior zone 3Y to balance strength, veneering if needed.
map.前牙美学区偏 4Y/5Y（高透），后牙咬合力区偏 3Y（高强度）；具体由修复科医: Anterior aesthetic zone leans 4Y/5Y (high-translucent), posterior occlusal zone leans 3Y (high-strength); specifically set by the prosthodontist combining occlusal force and opposing teeth.
map.透光率决定修复体是否显死白、有无层次；过高透在深底色牙上可能透出基色，需饰瓷或选: Translucency decides whether the restoration looks dead white and has depth; too high translucency over a dark substrate may show the base color, needing veneering or a moderate generation.
map.重要。比色偏差会让修复体在自然光下突兀；本工具仅作代次初筛，正式比色与粘接由医师: Yes. Shade error makes the restoration stand out under natural light; this tool is only a generation pre-screening; formal shade-taking and bonding are done by the dentist.
